Any suggestion, from anyone, with no commitment attached. Ideas wait in the idea log until the product manager looks across them for patterns.

- **Definition:** [Glossary: Idea, Idea log](/system/glossary)
- **How it works:** [08 Request triage and the idea log](/system/request-triage-and-idea-log)
- **Owner:** product manager owns the log; anyone adds
- **Links to:** [Initiative](/templates/initiative)

## Template

Only the first two fields are required. Anyone can log an idea with just those; the rest get filled in at triage or when the product manager mines the log.

| Field | What goes here |
|---|---|
| Idea (required) | In the submitter's words: the problem they want solved, or a thought on a solution. No cleanup needed |
| Source (required) | Who submitted it, and when |
| Who does this help? | Who benefits beyond the person asking. Feeds the idea-for-improvement test |
| Type | Large or strategic / Idea for improvement |
| Related goal | Only if it's obvious |
| Tags | Theme, service area, user group |
| Related requests | Links to similar ideas or small requests |
| Status | Needs review / Mined into [Initiative] / Future consideration / Closed (reason). Future consideration means not yes, not no, and the requester was told we won't follow up |

## DMV example

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| Idea | "Show a document checklist before someone comes in for a new license." |
| Source | Counter clerk, Jan 15 |
| Who does this help? | Every first-time applicant, and the counter staff who turn them away |
| Type | Idea for improvement |
| Related goal | Goal 2: zero multi-trip experiences for standard licenses |
| Tags | New driver license, in-person visits |
| Related requests | Two earlier ideas about "bring the right papers" |
| Status | Mined into Initiative "Single-trip new driver licenses" at Q2 planning |
